zh.title: NOEMI Aerospace與印度及菲律賓業者簽署水上飛機協議
zh.summary: NOEMI Aerospace於2026年8月簽署兩項協議；旨在探索亞洲電動兩棲機營運
body: 挪威飛機製造商 NOEMI Aerospace 於 2026 年 8 月簽署了兩項獨立協議，以探索在印度與菲律賓的電動兩棲機營運。
NOEMI 於 2026 年 8 月 10 日與印度直升機營運商 Pawan Hans 簽署備忘錄（MoU），旨在探索於印度進行區域空中運輸的電動水上飛機方案。
該合作案將重點評估印度市場的營運概念、基礎設施需求及商業機會。
2026 年 8 月 12 日，NOEMI 宣布與菲律賓水上飛機營運商 Horizon Sun Charters (HSC) 簽署另一項備忘錄，後者有意採購三架 NOEMI 飛機，並保有兩架的選擇權。

en.title: NOEMI Aerospace signs seaplane deals with India and Philippine operators
en.summary: NOEMI Aerospace signs agreements in August 2026; exploring electric amphibious aircraft operations
body: Norwegian aircraft manufacturer NOEMI Aerospace is expanding its footprint in Asia through two separate agreements signed in August 2026 to explore electric amphibious aircraft operations.
On August 10, 2026, NOEMI signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Pawan Hans, an Indian helicopter operator, to explore introducing electric seaplanes for regional air transport in India.
The partnership with Pawan Hans will focus on evaluating operational concepts, infrastructure needs, and commercial opportunities within the Indian market.
On August 12, 2026, NOEMI announced a separate MoU with Philippine seaplane operator Horizon Sun Charters (HSC), which intends to acquire three NOEMI aircraft with options for two additional units.
